title: Total knee arthroplasty for osteoarthritis
disclaimer: Illustrative criteria written for this demo project. Not an actual Medicare, Medicaid, or commercial payer policy.

criteria.text: Radiographic evidence of advanced osteoarthritis of the affected knee (Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 or 4, or bone-on-bone changes).
Function-limiting knee pain for at least 3 months.
At least 3 months of failed non-surgical management (physical therapy, weight management, NSAIDs, or intra-articular injections).
BMI below 40, or documented medical/surgical clearance if BMI is 40 or higher.
